description: This file contains extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization using System.Text.Json. It provides helper methods to convert objects to and from JSON strings with case-insensitive property matching.

classes.name: JsonExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: FromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an object of type T using specified JSON options.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T into a JSON string using specified JSON options.
